name: Thinking Glyph
description: A small animated glyph and a label with a passing band of light that say what an agent is doing right now.

props.name: variant
props.description: The glyph: a six-armed crystal, widening rings, three lines filling in turn, or a line that writes itself.

props.name: label
props.description: What the agent is doing. Defaults to the variant's name, such as "Searching".

props.name: showElapsed
props.description: Shows the time since the indicator appeared, counted in seconds.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When the work began, as a timestamp in milliseconds (Date.now()). The elapsed time counts from then, so it survives a remount. Without it, counting starts when the indicator appears.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. It is a status region, so a label change is announced.
